one_line_summary: An arts education program for youth in Los Angeles, providing a summer arts camp with enrichment programming.
mission: To provide youth with the tools to create, connect, and heal through art, wellness, and community.

programs.name: Summer Arts Camp
programs.description: Immersive workshops in visual arts, music production, dance, and creative entrepreneurship, led by industry professionals.
programs.population_served: Youth ages 12-18 from underserved Los Angeles-area communities; the 2025 camp aimed to engage 100 youth, with a focus on accessibility, diversity, and empowerment.
